summary: Experimental document on synchronizing service boundaries and mapping elements between servers using the Location-to-Service Translation (LoST) protocol. LoST maps a location to a service, such as the right emergency call center. This keeps the servers' data consistent.

eli5.summary: A map says which fire station covers which streets. This memo helps map-keeping computers copy updated boundaries from each other so they all agree.

questions: how to sync lost mapping data
